title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We're excited to announce that Spyglass has officially launched, bringing its powerful capabilities to all users.

title: Powerful File Control
summary: Gain complete command over your content with our powerful new file control, enabling you to effortlessly upload, manage, and customize how all your embedded files appear within the editor.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap
summary: We've launched a dynamic new public roadmap to provide clear visibility into our latest accomplishments, immediate priorities, and exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Our enhanced checkboxes are now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, offering a seamless and modern way to track your progress.

title: Improved Real-Time Collaboration
summary: Our latest update significantly enhances real-time collaboration within the editor, providing a more intuitive and seamless experience for teams working together.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Discovery
summary: Now you can effortlessly find and view all shared items from your friends and collaborators, making teamwork and discovery more integrated than ever.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language
summary: Noeko is thrilled to introduce comprehensive support for a wide array of international languages, empowering users globally.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to announce Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the project's evolution.

title: Smarter Knowledge Graph Exploration
summary: Discover deeper connections and streamline your workflow with advanced filtering by tags and time, plus effortless sharing options for your dynamic visual knowledge map.

title: Enhanced Search & Custom Collections
summary: Effortlessly find and organize your information with advanced filtering and sorting capabilities, allowing you to save tailored views for instant access to your personalized knowledge collections.

title: Dynamic Content Previews for Better Notes
summary: Experience new, dynamic ways to visualize and interact with your linked notes, empowering you to structure your thoughts more intuitively and efficiently.

title: Noeko: Your Data, Your Way, with Premium Options
summary: Prepare for Noeko's full release, empowering you with the choice to self-host your data and unlock advanced features through new premium plans.

title: Revamped Themes and Fresh Styles
summary: Experience a more beautiful and customizable interface with refined existing themes and a brand new selection of captivating designs.

title: Smarter Time-Based Greetings
summary: Enjoy a perfectly timed welcome on your homepage with greetings that accurately reflect the time of day, enhancing your personal experience.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Easily manage your tagged content by performing actions like removing tags directly from a list view, significantly boosting your productivity.

title: Expand Your Knowledge Sources
summary: Effortlessly bring in information from a wider array of sources, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, to centralize and interact with all your essential content directly within the platform.
